title: Feature request: add `--strict` mode for triage completeness
body:
## Problem
New maintainers are unsure when an issue has enough details to proceed.

## Use case
When triaging weekly backlog, we want a stricter threshold so incomplete bug reports are consistently labeled.

## Expected outcome
A `--strict` option that marks bug reports as incomplete unless repro, expected/actual, env, and logs are all present.

## Alternatives considered
- Contributor handbook checklist only
- Manual reviewer notes in issue comments

## Non-goals
No automatic issue closing.
